The claim's own text concedes that no substantive evidence links pattern matching to teaching, leadership, estimation, sequencing, scope, organization, craft, productivity, or study, which means it fails its own burden. Finally, the stated confidence of 0.20 is itself an admission of near-vacuum, yet the claim is dressed as a research conclusion. A title plus an abstract is not data. Verdict: reject.
